_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.2 TASK_ACK + A.3 TASK_CLAIM
_note: Harness Engineering work under LEGEND_CORE §21e (T0, no gate, no Mirror precondition). DEFAULTS_TAKEN and STOP_LOG are recorded HERE and not only in the final message, because retrospective § 9.7 measured that every default taken during ten unattended hours on 2026-09-09 lived in a transcript: a repository-wide grep found DEFAULTS_TAKEN in two files, and the baseline for waves carrying both keys was 0 of 11.

TASK_ACK.objective: Retrospective § 9.2: every screen must say what it screened — a shared verdict contract carrying the digest of exactly the bytes screened, and the conversion of the screens to it. Retrospective § 9.3: a meta-test measuring whether each tool's own suite ever drives the tool's top-level entry point, with at least one case drawn from a real corpus artefact.
TASK_ACK.review_requirement: none — harness is T0 under §21e; Mirror reviews ex post and on request

TASK_CLAIM.timestamp_precision: date only — the runtime exposed no wall-clock time
TASK_CLAIM.uniqueness: no competing claim exists for this TASK_ID + GENERATION

deliberately_not_touched.framework/scripts/dependency_integrity.p: peer-owned; carries a reconciliation point for this contract (see PEER_FINDINGS_REPORTED_NOT_FIXED)
deliberately_not_touched.disease-models/**: not this task's perimeter; the retrospective is read-only input
deliberately_not_touched.scripts/legend_commit.sh: shared commit wrapper in concurrent use by three actors

9_2_screens.method: each screen handed a zero-length input, an absent path, and a real input; verdict and digest read off the returned record. Re-derived this session rather than taken from the retrospective.
9_2_screens.baseline_retrospective_claim: 1 of 7 refuses an uninformative pass; 0 of 7 report the digest of what they screened

baseline_as_re_measured.refuses_an_uninformative_pass: 1 of 7 strictly (genre_discriminator, a named INSUFFICIENT_DATA); 2 of 7 if oa_status_dissent's UNDETERMINED counts, which names a cause but not which input is missing
worked_examples_of_the_defect: text_surface_intrusion_check.py on a zero-byte file printed 'OK: no page furniture found inside a sentence'
find_intrusions(path_string) returned [] — the empty list a caller reads as CLEAN, the 2026-09-09 inversion present in this tool too
manifest_flag_drift.scan() of an untracked manifest returned [] = PASS
locator_identifier_provenance on an empty manifest returned four zero counts
erratum_scope_check.check_manifest returned None, and main dropped those manifests from every count

after.refuses_an_uninformative_pass: 6 of 6 converted, each naming the missing input
after.seventh_screen: _refuse_suspect_surface, inside peer-owned deepdive_manifest.py; the contract module and its suite are what that peer imports

corpus_effects_measured.manifest_flag_drift: 81 manifests: before, one aggregate PASS over all 81; after, 45 screened and 36 INSUFFICIENT_DATA (44% were single-revision and never comparable)
corpus_effects_measured.locator_identifier_provenance: 81 manifests: before, measurable 26; after, REFUSED 12, CLEAN 4, artefacts absent 54, no identifier in any proposition 11 — the last 11 had been counted as measured
corpus_effects_measured.erratum_scope_check: 81 examined: 63 CLEAN, 0 REFUSED, 18 INSUFFICIENT_DATA, of which 12 never raised the erratum question and had appeared in no number the tool printed

corpus_effects_measured.genre_discriminator: control run over 18 real deposits: 4 of 12 declared-primary flagged UNDER_DESCRIBED, two of which are published corrections

9_3_entry_point_coverage.method: every suite executed under a profiler recording each Python function entered and each file opened, in the suite process and in every subprocess it spawns. Not a static grep — a static grep would be a fourth instance of the defect being measured.
9_3_entry_point_coverage.criterion: entry_point_called = main entered AND at least one direct callee of main that is not the self-test dispatch. real_artifact_case = a file opened under files/, disease-models/, ledger/, framework/state/ or _external_repos/ — three-state, degrading to skipped_declared when the bytes are absent.

baseline.note: measured over the 46 qualifying scripts that pre-dated this task (the sweep as run covered 48, two of which were this task's own new files)

9_3_entry_point_coverage.validated_against_real_history: erratum_scope_check.py measured at 0e33f0f^ and 0e33f0f: before the orchestrator's repair the self-test exits 0 (12/12 green) with entry_point_called false and callees_entered empty; after it, true with check_manifest entered. A fixture written by this tool's own author could not have proved the criterion; the two commits can.
9_3_entry_point_coverage.false_negative_check: three of the 21 false readings verified by hand before the number was trusted: test_legend_lint.py calls lint() directly, test_oa_status_dissent.py calls assess(), test_text_surface_intrusion_check.py calls find_intrusions(). None enters main. The readings are true negatives, not instrumentation artefacts.

MUTATION_TESTING.rule_applied: every shipped change had its defect reintroduced, the failing and passing cases recorded, the defect restored, and green re-shown. Matrices are in the commit messages.

holes_found_by_mutation_that_reading_did.mutation: R4 — a run that screened nothing exits 0
holes_found_by_mutation_that_reading_did.outcome: SURVIVED: no case asserted a non-zero exit when nothing could be screened, which is this task's own failure class one level up. Case written, R4 re-run, now turns it red.

SURVIVED: the tool already returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA for an unmeasurable deposit, so both cases stayed green while the verdict named 'page_span, references' as the missing input for a surface that was never there. The cases now assert WHAT IS NAMED; U1 turns them red.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The retrospective's § 9.2 baseline (1 of 7 refusing an uninformative pass) did not match my own re-measurement exactly: oa_status_dissent already returned a named UNDETERMINED verdict.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Reported both readings — 1 of 7 by the retrospective's strict criterion, 2 of 7 if UNDETERMINED counts — and targeted 7 of 7 unambiguously rather than arguing the denominator.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The target and the work are identical under either reading; only the headline delta changes, and both numbers are stated.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Had I adopted the retrospective's number without deriving it, I would have reported a delta of +6 where the honest figure is +5 or +6 depending on a definition — the exact class of value § 9.4 exists to prevent.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The seventh screen, _refuse_suspect_surface, lives in peer-owned deepdive_manifest.py.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Did not touch it. Made the contract module importable with a docstring carrying a complete worked example, and the suite EXECUTES that example rather than only displaying it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Preserves the file division that produced zero cross-actor collisions in eleven waves (§ 4.4). The peer needs no conversation with me to implement.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: If the peer's conversion needs a contract change, that is a follow-up task on my module, not an edit to theirs.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The durable fix for the missing-executable-bit red is mechanical and belongs in scripts/legend_commit.sh, which three actors are committing through right now; the coordinator suggested a tool-shipping checklist, and no such checklist file exists in the repository.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Restored the bit by hand, recommended the wrapper change to the coordinator whose file it is, and declined to create a second home for a rule test_release_surface.py already owns canonically.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: A bash defect in the shared wrapper halts two peers mid-sweep; the manual repair is instant and the suite catches every recurrence.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: If the coordinator takes the wrapper change, this stops recurring; if not, it recurs and the suite keeps catching it after the fact rather than before.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The § 9.3 meta-test's full sweep takes ~4 minutes, and every test_*.py is auto-enrolled in the release battery by discovery.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Split the tool (self_test_coverage.py, run on demand for the corpus-wide number) from its suite (test_self_test_coverage.py, 13 cases in 16s, including the two real historical commits). The suite proves the criterion; the tool produces the census.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The battery stays fast, and the property that matters is pinned by a suite that runs every time. The census is reproducible with one command.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Enrolling the full sweep would have added ~4 minutes to every release run to re-derive a number that changes only when a suite changes.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: genre_discriminator's real-corpus control could assert either 'no ordinary primary deposit is UNDER_DESCRIBED' or 'not every one is'. Measured: 4 of 12, two of them published corrections that are genuinely short against a bare Journal Article label, and the primary/review column is a coarse stand-in for real PubMed types.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Asserted what the B13 defect actually was — EVERY ordinary primary flagged — and reported the 4 of 12 as a number rather than a failure.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The assertion is true by measurement and would have gone red on the B13 version. A stricter one would fail for legitimate reasons and train readers to ignore the tool.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: A stricter assertion would be red today for two corrections that the tool is arguably describing correctly.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: evidence_presence.py is inside my declared ownership but is not one of § 9.2's seven screens; it reads true/false on the § 9.3 axes.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Left unconverted and named in the report. It is not at false/false, so it does not stand between this task and its stated target.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: No regression: its suite is green and unchanged.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: A real-artefact case for it is a small follow-up; nothing depends on it.

_stop_log_note: Empty, and recorded empty deliberately. No class-1 stop (no reserved act was required: no push, no history rewrite, no deletion of unique material, no spend, no private-data exposure, no BATCH_COMMIT) and no class-2 stop (every condition above had a safe default). The coordinator's mid-task message about the executable bit was acted on immediately and is not a stop.

PEER_FINDINGS_REPORTED_NOT_FIXED.finding: 4 of 14 cases red, and red BEFORE this task began (recorded in the pre-work baseline). Failures are 'Refusing to discard destination work' not raised, and a lossless-roundtrip RESUME_FAIL on a dirty-patch/HEAD mismatch.

PEER_FINDINGS_REPORTED_NOT_FIXED.finding: Its docstring records that screen_verdict.py did not exist when it was written, so it carries the same shape in-module (an explicit `screened` boolean beside the verdict) and names its VERDICTS block as the surface to reconcile. screen_verdict.py has now landed (1ef620f).
PEER_FINDINGS_REPORTED_NOT_FIXED.why_not_fixed: Peer-owned. The reconciliation is theirs to make; the contract, its guards and its worked example are in place for it.

PEER_FINDINGS_REPORTED_NOT_FIXED.finding: dossier_quote_audit, figure_ppi_preflight, generate_semantic_graph, harness_session_start, pmc_pow_fetch, pubmed_clipboard_to_seed, pubmed_corpus_harvest, recapture_snippets, regenerate_adjudications, task_close — none enters its own main(); the CLI path (argument parsing, discovery, exit codes) is certified by suites that never run it.

ATTRIBUTION_CENSUS._counted_by: retrospective § 0.2. A catcher is machine (validator/linter/test suite/shell), blind auditor, peer/coordinator, or self (re-reading, cross-measurement, control run, or refusal to believe an unearned result).

_incidents.what: Shipped screen_verdict.py and its suite without the executable bit; scripts/test_release_surface.py went red.
Mutation R4 SURVIVED: nothing asserted that manifest_flag_drift exits non-zero when it screened nothing — a caller checking only for zero would read silence as a clean corpus.

Mutation U1 SURVIVED: genre_discriminator's two new cases stayed green with the input guard removed, because the tool's own INSUFFICIENT_DATA masked it; the verdict then named the wrong missing input.
oa_status_dissent --json let the domain record's `verdict` key overwrite the screen verdict: two vocabularies, one key, and the tool printed a word the screen contract never emits.
Asserted that PMID38499540 still declares multihop.performed true; the manifest says false — the claim was retracted after the sweep. An assumption asserted with the confidence of a measurement.
_incidents.catcher: machine (the test I had just written failed against the corpus)

_incidents.what: self_test_coverage detected --self-test by substring, so it invoked `self_test_coverage.py --self-test`, which its own CLI does not accept, and reported a failing suite that does not exist — a measurement confounded by prose about the measurement.
